## About

U-PINO combines Fourier spectral blocks, a U-Net-style encoder-decoder, and an eikonal-consistency loss to predict a full travel-time field from DAS arrival-time observations [@alqadasi2026upino]. The source is localized at the predicted travel-time minimum.

## Why it matters

Fast localization supports monitoring of stimulation and stress evolution in geothermal reservoirs. Purely data-driven surrogates may lose physical consistency, while repeated numerical eikonal solutions can be too expensive for near-real-time use.

## Key result and audience

The accepted paper reports up to a 78% reduction in travel-time RMSE relative to a plain FNO baseline and roughly 50% less training time per epoch for the evaluated configuration. The repository supports Utah FORGE experiments, field-event examples, and FNO comparisons for DAS and induced-seismicity researchers.
